title: Cut size, keep area
hook: Does splitting this fully exposed sheet add face area?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: Splitting a flat rectangle preserves the combined front-and-back face area. It adds edges, but does not double the large faces; separating folded layers is a different operation.

misconception: The two pictured methods are interchangeable without checking their mechanism or constraints.

recall.question: A flat 80 × 120 cm sheet, fully exposed, is cut into two 80 × 60 cm halves. What happens to the total face area?
recall.why: Each half has half the face area, so together they match the original: 2 × 0.8 × 1.2 = 1.92 m² either way. Cutting adds edges; only opening a folded sheet reveals hidden faces.
